segments.name: Full service center-based child care
products: traditional center-based early education and child care
segments.description: Provides center-based early education and child care at or near employer worksites and community locations for working families.
segments.evidence: Full service center-based child care includes traditional center-based early education and child care, preschool, and elementary education.

segments.name: Back-up care
products: in-home care for children and seniors
segments.description: Provides dependent care coverage for all ages when regular care is unavailable, plus care coordination tools for families.
segments.evidence: Back-up care includes center-based back-up child care, in-home care for children and seniors, school-age programs (including camps and tutoring), pet care, self-sourced reimbursed care, and Sittercity, an online marketplace for families and caregivers.

segments.name: Educational advisory services
products: tuition assistance and student loan repayment program management
segments.description: Provides education-related services helping employees upskill and advance careers and families achieve higher education goals.
segments.evidence: Educational advisory services consist of tuition assistance and student loan repayment program management, workforce education, related educational advising, and college admissions counseling services.
